episodes.155259: A front moving from the west and northwest brought heavy showers and isolated thunderstorms to the islands, and some hail to the Big Island.  The rain caused ponding on roadways, and small stream and drainage ditch flooding.  No serious injuries or property damage were reported.
episodes.155557: A cold front swept eastward through northeast Ohio during the early morning hours of February 5th as a deep and occluded surface low moved from northern Lake Michigan toward far-eastern Lake Superior. A tight surface pressure gradient and rapid surface pressure rises behind the front contributed to a peak gust of nearly 50 knots at Lorain Harbor.
episodes.157155: West winds briefly gusted to storm force at Stannard Rock Light late afternoon on the 5th in the wake of a storm system tracking across the Mackinac Straits.

events.narrative: Lorain Harbor C-MAN Station (LORO1) recorded a peak wind gust of 57 mph.
